title: SMOK RPM 85 & RPM 100 Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: The SMOK RPM 85 and RPM 100 vape kits from Smoktech are ideal for vapers who enjoy long, sub-ohm vaping sessions but prefer a less bulky and unwieldy device. These replacement pods are compatible with both devices and offer an e-liquid capacity of 2ml. The pods are easily refilled via a clever sliding top-fill design slide the cap out to reveal the fill port, top up with e-liquid, seal, and you’re good to go. The pod attaches to the RPM 85/ RPM100 mod with strong magnets, and Smok have also introduced a genius lock at the bottom of the pod that prevents the accidental removal of the coil as well as leaks. These Smok RPM 85 / RPM 100 pods are compatible with Smok’s RPM 2 (sold separately) which are easily installed via a push-to-fit design. Together with the RPM 2 coils and the RPM 85 / RPM 100 vape kit, you can enjoy a fantastically flavoursome DTL (direct-to-lung) experience when used with 70% VG, sub-ohm e-liquids.
